sequence.description: Amino acids in uppercase one-letter codes; _ marks a masked residue to fill in. Whitespace is ignored. At most 1,024 residues. Multi-chain complexes (| chain breaks) are not covered.

length.description: Protein length, when no sequence is given (all residues masked).

structure.description: A protein structure as a PDB file. The first model is read: ATOM records of amino acids (HETATM ignored), one chain, the first alternate location of each atom. N, CA and C are used (at least one residue needs all three). Plain text, UTF-8 or Latin-1; a gzip file is refused.

chain.description: Chain to read from the PDB file (default: the first).

structure_residues.description: [first, last] residues of the file's chain to use (1-indexed, default: all).

structure_at.description: Prompt position where that structure segment starts (default 1): place a motif inside a longer protein.

secondary_structure.description: Eight-class DSSP secondary structure, one letter per residue (G H I T E B S C); _ for unknown.

sasa.description: Solvent-accessible surface area per residue in square angstrom; null for unknown.

num_steps.description: Unmasking steps, capped at the number of residues. Default: residues / 16, at least 1 (the maker's function example).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 takes the most likely token.

temperature_annealing.description: Anneal the temperature over the steps, as the maker's default: (T - step/(steps-1))^2, at least 1e-6.

schedule.description: How many positions stay masked after each step.

strategy.description: Which masked positions to fill first: random, or lowest entropy.

seed.description: Random seed (default: a new one, returned in the reply).

condition_on_coordinates_only.description: With a structure prompt, condition on its coordinates and mask its structure tokens (the maker's default, true).

structure_sequence.description: With a structure file and no sequence, take the residues of the placed segment from the file (the maker's ESMProtein.from_protein_chain); false leaves them masked.
